title: merge --fix-check accepts a reviewed head on a PR that already has other records
why: Degen sent six PRs back to a full round 1 on Nov 12 after a passed fix check (D25). #2940 accepts a fix check on a PR with no record at all, but a PR with other records still needs HEAD to be the newest record's Head, which is the Degen case.
source: coordinator 23:31 CST Nov 12; retrospective 23:27 CST (Degen ledger D25); open gap on step review-record-fix-check-reads (#2940)
note: After #2940 merges. Red test first: a PR whose newest record has another Head, and a fix check naming a reviewed head with a review record of its own, is accepted; a fix check naming a head with no record still refuses. Check decision pr-review-record (the --fix-check order) before changing the HEAD rule; if the change departs from an owner ruling there, it goes to the owner. Express: not on the R55 list, so normal queue unless the owner adds it.
